name: Industrial & Medical Gases Nigeria Plc
source: Industrial and Medical Gases Nigeria Plc condensed statement of comprehensive income for Jan-Jun 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), thousands scaled to naira. EPS as printed in kobo converted to naira and confirmed against 731,064,000 ordinary shares. Net finance income is stored negative; operating expenses are other expenses, foreign exchange losses, selling and distribution and administrative expenses. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | FY2025 and FY2024 re-read from the audited statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, page 26 of the FY2025 annual report: Finance income 48,350 and Finance expenses 6,253 give a net finance income of 42,097 and Income Tax expense 820,222 (FY2024) replaces a placeholder that broke Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Profit for the year. EPS is the printed basic and diluted earnings per share (162 and 295 kobo). | CRON 20261117: 9M 2026 (nine months ended 30 September 2026) added from Industrial and Medical Gases Nigeria Plc Q3 2026 report, condensed statement of comprehensive income page 2, nine month 2026 column, the second printed column after the jul-sep quarter, printed in thousands of naira and stored x1,000. Printed at that column: revenue 5,887,409; cost of sales -3,470,457; gross profit 2,416,952; other income 40,502; other expenses 20,487 plus foreign exchange losses 54,890 plus selling and distribution 723,958 plus administrative 1,063,762 (operating expenses 1,863,097); operating profit 594,357; finance income 190,568 with no finance cost printed at that column, stored as a negative Net Finance Costs because it is income, the sign this file already uses; profit before income tax 784,925; income tax provision 224,910; net profit 560,015; basic and diluted earnings per share 77 kobo, stored as 0.77 naira to match the EPS unit already in this file. Ties exactly: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit; gross profit plus other income less the four expense lines equals the printed operating profit; operating profit plus net finance income equals profit before income tax; profit before income tax less income tax equals net profit.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.withhold_reason: withheld: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses does not equal the filed Operating Profit and the file carries no extra line that explains the gap, so the operating expenses (or operating profit) cannot be established from the statement; an honest blank beats a figure that fails its own arithmetic
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file

rows.label: EPS

unitGuard.reason: unit guard: the EPS row for 9M 2026 read 770 against 0.822203 for that period's net profit divided by the shares on file, a factor of 936.5, which is the 1000x multiple of a per-share figure printed in a sub-unit (kobo / cents / a thousandth). Normalised to 0.77, the unit the price is quoted in.

rows.unitGuardBasis: factor = stored EPS / (the same period's net profit / shares on file); a factor within 15% of a power of ten (or its reciprocal) whose corrected value lands within 2.0x of the triangle is a UNIT error and is normalised; a stored cell of the opposite sign to the period's net profit whose magnitude is beyond 5.0x is WITHHELD with both figures named; every other cell is left exactly as filed

marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025; the operating expenses for those periods are withheld (see the row note). Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2024: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
nameNote: the statement carried only its ticker as the name; the name is taken from the exchange listing for IMG
